name: Shield Stance
description: Stand in the school's soul stance with the first shield raised before the mind.

name: Second Shield
description: Raise the second shield a half breath after the first so that blows pass between them.

name: Pairing Sense
description: Feel which of the two shields a hostile soul presses on harder.

name: Matched Stride
description: Move both shields forward in step so that the guard keeps its form on the advance.

name: Shield Knit
description: Knit the cracks of the nearer shield with calm drawn from the farther one.

name: Return Edge
description: Cant the shield so that part of a blow is sent back along the line it came.

name: Pair Anvil
description: Hold the shields as anvil and hammer so that a hostile soul is pressed between them.

name: Doubled Cleanse
description: Pass taint from an ally through the first shield and burn it off on the second.

name: Twinned Sovereign
description: Take in a barrage with the first shield and loose it again from the second.

name: Shield Verdict
description: The school's closing move that brings both shields together on a hostile soul and returns its force by the user's reserve.

name: Twin Rise
description: Rise in mind as a court and set the first guard between self and the hostile will.

name: Twin Answer
description: Answer a soul blow with a short firm turn that sends it back into the open.

name: Hearing Sense
description: Hear out the hostile soul as a court hears a plea and learn what it wants.

name: Written Calm
description: Set down a calm ruling over a troubled mind and let it ease the strain.

name: Bench Guard
description: Raise a broad bench of will that seats allies behind it safe from a spread of force.

name: Plea Refusal
description: Refuse a forced plea of the will outright so that its force dies on the spot.

name: Gavel Strike
description: Bring a gavel of will down on a hostile focus and break its rhythm.

name: Sustained Ruling
description: Hold a ruling of guard in place over many breaths against a steady siege.

name: Appeal Cleanse
description: Hear the case of a tainted ally and strike the taint from them by decree.

name: Judgment Seat
description: Take the judging seat and bring down every hostile will beneath the court.

name: Paired Decree
description: The school's closing move in which the two minds decree an end to an assault and its force falls silent by the user's reserve.

name: Kite Perch
description: Perch the mind high and bright and let the guard form beneath it.

name: Sky Slide
description: Slide a strike off the guard and up into the open sky of the mind.

name: Keen Look
description: Take a keen look at the field of minds and pick the one that means harm.

name: Thermal Rest
description: Glide on a calm warm current of will until the soul's strain has gone.

name: Stoop Answer
description: Stoop on a hostile lash and throw part of its force back from above.

name: Blue Hush
description: Drop a blue hush over the mind that smothers the loud edge of a soul strike.

name: Talon Guard
description: Clasp a striking soul in guarding talons and hold it still until the blow is spent.

name: Wide Pinion
description: Spread a pinion of soul over allies and lend each of them the user's keen sight.

name: Zenith Cover
description: Rise to the zenith of the mind and take in a rain of hostile force while reading each source.

name: Azure Descent
description: The school's closing move in which the guard falls from above on a hostile soul and returns its force by the user's reserve.

name: Crown Base
description: Set the base of the soul crown on the core and ward the head of the mind.

name: First Track
description: Run the first track of soul along the crown so that a blow is guided down and away.

name: Second Track
description: Run the second track the other way round the crown to balance the first.

name: Rail Sense
description: Read the hum of both tracks to find where a hostile force bends them.

name: Meeting Point
description: Bring the two tracks to meet at the crown so that every strike falls on both.

name: Crown Salve
description: Pour the calm of both tracks into the wounded soul of an ally.

name: Core Lend
description: Lend the strength of the core to the crown of an ally so that both guard as one.

name: Track Wipe
description: Wipe the tracks clean of foreign will and pass the clearing to an ally.

name: Company Crown
description: Cast the crown wide over a whole company so that all share the same guard.

name: Convergent Return
description: Draw a blow down both tracks to the core and fling it back as one.

name: Crown Sovereign
description: Take a whole assault into the crown and pour its force into the guarded company.

name: Dual Crown Fall
description: The school's closing move that sets both tracks as one crown over a company and stills every hostile will by the user's reserve.

name: Held Stance
description: Take the oath stance with the mind still and the wind outside the ward.

name: Wind Parting
description: Part a push of will round the mind as the wind parts round a standing tree.

name: Oath Weathervane
description: Judge by the feel of the air of will which way the hostile wind is turning.

name: Rested Oath
description: Rest on the oath until the aching of a long push has quite gone.

name: Reed Bend
description: Bend with the blow as a reed bends and rise again when it has gone.

name: Sworn Share
description: Share the oath with an ally in a single word so that they hold as well.

name: Gust Hold
description: Hold the oath through a full gale of will without giving or breaking.

name: Taint Carry
description: Let the wind carry hostile taint out of an ally and leave the air clean.

name: Tempest Sovereign
description: Take in a tempest of will and let the oath still it to nothing.

name: Oath Unshaken
description: The school's closing move that rests wholly on the oath and quiets an assault of will in a measure set by the user's reserve.

name: Level Stance
description: Take the level stance of the school with the mind open and quiet.

name: Broad Turn
description: Spread the calm wide so that a narrow blow loses itself across it.

name: Long View
description: Take the long view across the level calm and note any stirring far away.

name: Slow Light
description: Pour slow golden calm over a weary mind until it grows level again.

name: Level Cover
description: Lay the calm over allies at the user's side like a still sky.

name: Quiet Breaker
description: Break the crest of a surge of will against the unmoving calm.

name: Stirless Hold
description: Hold a mind so still that foreign taint settles out of it and can be lifted.

name: Broad Calm
description: Cast the calm out over a whole group so that none is shaken.

name: Plateau Reply
description: Answer a surge of will with the full level weight of the calm sent straight back.

name: Sovereign Level
description: Make the whole field level and calm so that hostile force sinks and allies steady.

name: Unstirred Calm
description: The school's closing move that lays the calm over the whole contest and stills every hostile will by the user's reserve.

name: Course Take
description: Take one clear bearing in the mind and hold the guard along it.

name: True Lean
description: Lean along the bearing so that a pull from the side finds no grip.

name: Compass Feel
description: Feel the needle of the bearing swing and read the force that moves it.

name: Needle Rest
description: Let the needle come to rest and ease the mind that had been wrenched.

name: Pull Dull
description: Dull a hostile pull by turning the mind a degree against it.

name: Shared Needle
description: Share the true bearing with an ally and steady their wavering mind.

name: Fixed Reckoning
description: Reckon the position of the mind once and refuse every force that would move it.

name: Drift Cleanse
description: Clear the drift of a forced thought from an ally and return their bearing.

name: Polar Sovereign
description: Hold the pole of the bearing and let allies steer by it while greater pulls fade.

name: Bearing Absolute
description: The school's closing move that sets the bearing beyond all pulls and cancels a greater will in a weight set by the user's reserve.

name: Storm Root
description: Send the oath down like a root so that the soul stands fast beneath a storm.

name: Thunder Shed
description: Let a crash of will pass overhead and leave the rooted soul untouched.

name: Cloud Read
description: Read the gathering clouds of will and tell when the next blow will fall.

name: Root Drink
description: Draw calm up through the roots into a soul scorched by lightning will.

name: Bolt Diversion
description: Ground the bolt of a hostile soul strike through the oath and into nothing.

name: Sworn Gather
description: Gather allies beneath the oath so that all stand rooted together.

name: Gentle Downpour
description: Let a cleansing rain of calm wash taint and erosion from the souls of allies.

name: Core Anchor
description: Bind the oath to the core and bear a long storm of will unharmed.

name: Storm Return
description: Send the storm's force back through the oath at the one who raised it.

name: Beneath Sovereign
description: Take the whole storm beneath the oath and loose it again as a single stroke.

name: Deepest Oath
description: The school's closing move that rests on the deepest oath and ends a storm of wills in a weight set by the user's reserve.
